title: FitnessAnalysis Weight Reading
description: Standardized schema for a single body-weight reading, normalized across source apps (manually logged in Google Fit, synced from Hevy) via a Google Takeout export. Not activity data -- see data/body_metrics/README.md.

id.description: Unique identifier for this reading. Google Fit weight points have no id of their own, so this is derived from the reading's nanosecond timestamp.

source.description: Platform the data was retrieved from (a Google Takeout export of Google Fit data).

original_source.description: Where the reading actually originated before landing in Google Fit: typed directly into the Fit app, or synced in from Hevy.

recorded_at.description: When the reading was taken/logged, ISO 8601.

weight_kg.description: Weight in kilograms, as stored by Google Fit (its native unit).

weight_lb.description: Weight in pounds, derived from weight_kg for convenience -- this project's narrative context (see data/context/life_events.json) is generally discussed in pounds.

ingested_at.description: Timestamp when this record was parsed/ingested into the repository.
